WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
), side_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count
  FROM side_counts
)
SELECT SUM(sc.order_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(sc.order_count - sa.avg_count) AS avg_excess
FROM side_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa
WHERE sc.order_count > sa.avg_count;
